pages: Wiremu Waitoa, a boy of fourteen, short black hair, a grey sweatshirt with the cuffs pushed up, worn jeans, at a kitchen table over one sheet of paper, a box drawn round a line, one end of a ruler on it. Middle distance: a kitchen window, a chair. Background: a paling fence, a paddock. Afternoon light across the table.

Wiremu Waitoa, a boy of fourteen, short black hair, a grey sweatshirt with the cuffs pushed up, worn jeans, at the kitchen table with one finger on the edge of the drawn box, the ruler laid along it. Middle distance: the photocopied sheet, a homework book, a mug. Background: a window, the shed roof. Low afternoon sun on the paper.

Wiremu Waitoa, a boy of fourteen, short black hair, a grey sweatshirt with the cuffs pushed up, worn jeans, at the kitchen table with one almanac open, a finger run down a column of figures. Middle distance: the drawn box on its sheet, a pencil, a mug. Background: a window, a washing line. Afternoon light on the figures.

Wiremu Waitoa, a boy of fourteen, short black hair, a grey sweatshirt with the cuffs pushed up, worn jeans, at a desk with one folded sheet of photographs of a cratered edge, a thumbnail on one crater. Middle distance: a school exercise book, a ruler, a pencil case. Background: a classroom window, a wall. Flat afternoon light.

Wiremu Waitoa, a boy of fourteen, short black hair, a grey sweatshirt with the cuffs pushed up, worn jeans, at the kitchen table with one strip of photographic charts spread out, a finger on a ridged edge. Middle distance: the almanac, a ruler, a school bag. Background: a window, a bare tree. Evening light on the charts.

Wiremu Waitoa, a boy of fourteen, short black hair, a grey sweatshirt with the cuffs pushed up, worn jeans, on the farm track at the gate with one map sheet held against the fence, a pencil on the drawn box. Middle distance: a gate, a fence post. Background: rolling country, a low ridge. Wide afternoon light.

Wiremu Waitoa, a boy of fourteen, short black hair, a grey sweatshirt with the cuffs pushed up, worn jeans, in the shearing shed over one plywood board, a pencil in the middle of a cut hole. Middle distance: a length of drainpipe, a sheet of perspex, two door handles. Background: shed wall, a dusty window. Daylight through the boards.

Wiremu Waitoa, a boy of fourteen, short black hair, a grey sweatshirt with the cuffs pushed up, worn jeans, at the shed wall with one clean disc of light on the boards, his arm out pointing at its edge. Middle distance: the board on a post, a saw, a pencil. Background: a low sun, long grass. Late afternoon light.

Wiremu Waitoa, a boy of fourteen, short black hair, a grey sweatshirt with the cuffs pushed up, worn jeans, side-on at the shed wall with one hairline ring of light on the boards, his head tilted to catch it. Middle distance: the board on its post, a stopwatch. Background: a dim shed interior, a doorway. Weak afternoon light.

Wiremu Waitoa, a boy of fourteen, short black hair, a grey sweatshirt with the cuffs pushed up, worn jeans, in the shed with one pencil marking a small cross on the wall, the disc of light above his hand. Middle distance: the board on its post, a folded chair. Background: shed wall, a strip of sky. Bright afternoon light.

Wiremu Waitoa, a boy of fourteen, short black hair, a grey sweatshirt with the cuffs pushed up, worn jeans, standing in the dim shed with one stopwatch flat in his palm, his thumb over the crown. Middle distance: the board on its post, a pencil. Background: a pale ring on the wall, shed boards. Grey afternoon light.

Wiremu Waitoa, a boy of fourteen, short black hair, a grey sweatshirt with the cuffs pushed up, worn jeans, in the shed doorway with one plywood board on its post, the wall behind it. Middle distance: a drainpipe, a folding chair, a stopwatch. Background: a low broken cloud, a paddock, hills. Bright afternoon light, cloud moving in.

Wiremu Waitoa, a boy of fourteen, short black hair, a grey sweatshirt with the cuffs pushed up, worn jeans, at the shed wall with one disc of light on the boards, a dark bite taken out of its west side. Middle distance: the board on its post, his sleeve. Background: the shed doorway, a cloud passing. Ordinary afternoon light.

Wiremu Waitoa, a boy of fourteen, short black hair, a grey sweatshirt with the cuffs pushed up, worn jeans, at the kitchen table with one open notebook, a pencil held over a column of times. Middle distance: the stopwatch, a folded chart, a mug. Background: a window, a wall of photographs. Evening light indoors.

Wiremu Waitoa, a boy of fourteen, short black hair, a grey sweatshirt with the cuffs pushed up, worn jeans, at a desk with one laptop open, a long message on the screen, his hand flat beside it. Middle distance: the drawn box on its sheet, a notebook, a pencil. Background: a bedroom window, a bed. Morning light from the side.

Wiremu Waitoa, a boy of fourteen, short black hair, a grey sweatshirt with the cuffs pushed up, worn jeans, at the kitchen table with one map sheet under his hand, a finger on the drawn line, an almanac open beside it. Middle distance: a notebook of numbers, a ruler, a mug. Background: a window, a shed roof. Late afternoon light.

Wiremu Waitoa, a boy of fourteen, short black hair, a grey sweatshirt with the cuffs pushed up, worn jeans, at the kitchen table with one photographic chart of the Moon's edge under a straightedge, a pencil on a peak. Middle distance: the open notebook, the laptop, a mug. Background: a window, evening. Warm light from a single lamp.

Wiremu Waitoa, a boy of fourteen, short black hair, a grey sweatshirt with the cuffs pushed up, worn jeans, at the kitchen table with one sheet with a second box drawn on it, a ruler along its western edge. Middle distance: the 2037 sheet, a pencil, a notebook. Background: a window, dusk outside. Table light on the paper.

Wiremu Waitoa, a boy of fourteen, short black hair, a grey sweatshirt with the cuffs pushed up, worn jeans, at the kitchen table with one chart sheet under his finger, the plywood board propped against the chair beside it. Middle distance: a straightedge, a notebook, a pencil. Background: a window, a dark shed roof. Evening light indoors.

Wiremu Waitoa, a boy of fourteen, short black hair, a grey sweatshirt with the cuffs pushed up, worn jeans, in the shearing shed with one pencil up to the board on the back of the door, two sets of figures on it. Middle distance: a work bench, a coil of rope. Background: an open door, fields. Last light through it.
